bullets.text: Under supervision, implemented reusable Python modules for the news retrieval workflow and wrote regression tests with pytest for malformed and edge-case inputs.
Under supervision, ranked public news summaries for provided queries using TF-IDF similarity in scikit-learn and checked retrieved documents against a small judged query set.
Under supervision, joined news document identifiers to publication metadata using SQL, checked unmatched records, visualized group comparisons, and documented missing-data handling.
Under supervision, implemented reusable Python modules for the product review retrieval workflow and wrote regression tests with pytest for malformed and edge-case inputs.

Under supervision, compared TF-IDF and pretrained sentence-embedding retrieval on held-out judged queries for public product reviews, examined recall at fixed cutoffs, and grouped retrieval errors by query type.
Under supervision, joined review document identifiers to product metadata using SQL, checked unmatched records, visualized group comparisons, and documented missing-data handling.
